description: This file initializes and renders the React application by attaching it to the DOM element with id 'root'. It imports React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component, then uses ReactDOM to render the App within React.StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to render a React component tree into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders a React element into the root container.
